parameters.content:
## STAGED: enquiry tracking
Deploy tracking migration and contact-automation-event first.
Select the Gmail credential and a Header Auth credential for every HTTP node.
Header: Authorization / Bearer plus the private CONTACT_AUTOMATION_SECRET.
Keep the secret out of workflow JSON and code.
Delivery stays OFF and Gmail nodes disabled until controlled tests pass.

Database claim prevents concurrent duplicate attempts. Gmail failures are uncertain: inspect Sent before manual intervention. Never automatically retry Send.

Unpublish the old workflow before activating this replacement. Never run both together.
Use a fresh startAfter timestamp; old emails are not reconstructed.

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().flatMap((item, index) => item.json.allowed === true ? [{json: $("Validate and match approved FAQ").itemMatching(index).json, pairedItem:{item:index}}] : []);
